title: Veggie egg muffins
summary: Mini egg muffins with grated veggies and a little cheese: soft, portable and freezer-friendly.
texture: Soft and springy, fully set in the middle. Offer whole for baby to bite or break into small soft pieces.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Brush a 12-cup mini muffin pan with oil.
Whisk the eggs, then stir in the zucchini, spinach and cheese.
Divide among the muffin cups, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until set all the way through and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool before serving.
choking: Grate or finely chop all vegetables so there are no hard pieces.
Make sure the egg is fully cooked with no runny middle.

allergens.name: Egg
allergens.note: Make sure egg has been introduced before serving this recipe.

allergens.name: Milk
allergens.note: Mozzarella is dairy. Leave it out if your baby avoids dairy.

storage: Fridge up to 3 days, or freeze up to 2 months. Reheat until hot, then cool before serving.
tips: Keep cheese to a small amount: most cheeses are salty.
Swap in grated carrot, finely chopped red pepper or mashed sweet potato.
